summary: Grim Fandango entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Grim Fandango

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC remaster with documented presentation settings

primary.why: The remaster is the current official route and includes higher-resolution character textures, dynamic lighting, a re-recorded orchestral score, developer commentary, and a concept art browser while preserving the classic adventure.
primary.how_to_play: Use Grim Fandango Remastered on PC. Record storefront/build, classic vs remastered visuals/audio preferences, control scheme, commentary state, and whether the original 1998 release is being compared.

all_releases.reason: skip: historical route; play only if preserving original engine/control behavior.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern PC route with remastered presentation and extras.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation / Nintendo Switch / Xbox / mobile Remastered routes
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced content advantage over PC for archive capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is the practical route, but original 1998 controls/engine quirks may matter for historical preservation.
